name: PAPEPO GDPR Scanner
author: PAPEPO

sections.description:
PAPEPO GDPR Scanner is an admin-only diagnostic that loads same-site URLs in a guest sandbox and matches resources against a local tracker dictionary (Google Fonts, GA/GTM, Meta, TikTok, LinkedIn, Bing UET, Clarity, Hotjar, HubSpot, Snap, Pinterest, X, Matomo Cloud, Mailchimp, Stripe/PayPal, YouTube/Vimeo, and more).

Features (all free)

  • Up to 3 same-site URLs per run (keeps scans light — not an upgrade gate)
  • Category cards: Fonts / Analytics / Marketing / Media / Other, with plain next-step tips
  • Friendly names from a local dictionary (no remote lookup)
  • Same-origin cookie names and localStorage/sessionStorage keys readable in the browser (HttpOnly / third-party cookies cannot be listed from JavaScript)
  • Last 5 scans saved for admins, with simple domain diff vs the previous saved scan
  • One-click Install / Activate / Open ConsentBase Free via WordPress core plugin APIs when you have permission

Not legal advice. Scores and detections are technical hints only. They do not prove compliance.

Works alongside free ConsentBase. Optional Pro extras are described on papepo.uk.

External Services

  • Links to https://wordpress.org/plugins/consentbase-gdpr/ and https://papepo.uk for related tools.
  • Optional install of ConsentBase Free uses WordPress.org plugin installation (core install-plugin flow) when the administrator has install_plugins capability.
  • The scan itself runs in the administrator’s browser via the Performance API and does not upload scan results to PAPEPO servers.
sections.installation:
1. Upload papepo-gdpr-scanner to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Open Tools → GDPR Scanner.
sections.faq:
Does this block trackers?

No. It only reports what this browser loaded. Use a consent tool such as ConsentBase if you need banners and script controls.

Why only 3 URLs?

To keep admin iframe scans reasonable on shared hosting. Raise the number in a future release if needed — it is not locked behind payment.

Why are some cookies missing?

JavaScript cannot read HttpOnly cookies or most third-party cookies. The list is a same-origin readability snapshot only.
